## Professional profile

Laksopan Ravindran is a Software Engineer with a BSc Hons in Information Technology from SLIIT. He builds full-stack web and mobile applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, Django, Flutter, cloud deployment, and AI-powered features.

## Selected work

- PortIntel: Offline port intelligence and process-safety desktop tool using React, TypeScript, Tauri, Rust, and ONNX.
- EduInsight: Laravel-based school management system with role-based workflows and an OpenAI-powered student assistant.
- SkillZone: Spring Boot and React social learning platform.
- ProteqHer SOS Listener: AI-powered mobile safety application in development.
